{{Quote|After the war, I learned from my parents that they had those feelings. They insulated me and their other children, my human brother and sisters, from them.|Viull Gorsat|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the son of [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Mulus Cheems]] and his [[Viull Gorsat's adopted mother|wife]]. He had at least two sisters and sometime during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], his parents adopted a young [[Viull Gorsat]] from the [[Shamed Ones|Shamed Ones]], the lowest [[Yuuzhan Vong castes|caste]] within the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] hierarchy.<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mulus Cheems's son was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth installment of the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''X-wing novel series'']] in [[2012]].<ref name="MK" />
